Mira (CS): quick note — a subset of EU onboarding tenants are seeing delayed embedding availability after nightly backfill; some similarity queries returning partial results :disappointed:
Dev (SRE): investigating. Early signal points to concurrency contention in reindex workers introduced by last night's deploy. We're throttling parallel backfills now to stop the retry storm.
Mira (CS): thanks. I'm drafting a short customer message. Need an ETA we can share and whether data loss is possible
AlertBot: Incident INC-4101234-EU-EMB created by Dev (SRE)  severity: medium  next update in 15m
Dev (SRE): mitigation applied: disabled concurrent backfills per shard and resumed single-writer processing. Error rate dropped from ~8% to ~0.5%. No data loss detected; reindex backlog per tenant varies (small ~20-30m, median ~50-70m, large up to 2h).
Lina (Product): recommend offering expedited manual reindex and a small onboarding credit to affected tenants. Also add a QA similarity sample check before closing tenant.
Mira (CS): draft outbound (short):

"Hi [Customer],

We detected intermittent delays in embedding indexing in our EU region between 2026-03-18 01:00-01:40 UTC. We applied a mitigation and background reindexing is underway.

What you may see: temporary incomplete similarity/search results until reindex finishes.

What we recommend: no action needed; reply if you want an expedited manual reindex. We are offering a one-time onboarding credit for impacted tenants.

Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Customer Success"

Mira (CS): Omar, please flag renewal-sensitive accounts so we can call them directly and offer priority reindex + credit
Omar (AE): will do. Pulling list now and will DM Mira. For renewal accounts I'll offer a 15% onboarding credit and a 30min troubleshooting session.
Dev (SRE): ops note for CS: when customers ask for ETA, use median estimate and we will post per-tenant completion timestamps here. Also advise that we ran integrity checks on reindexed shards so risk of quality regressions is low; Product will run extra sample checks.
Lina (Product): QA checklist: run 50-sample vector similarity test on each tenant; if drift > 2% escalate to ModelOps.
Mira (CS): added feedback form link to comm: https://forms.redwood.ai/embeds-feedback and office hours invite: https://meet.redwood.ai/officehours-eu today 15:00 UTC
AlertBot: INC-4101234-EU-EMB status update: mitigated  monitoring  next update 4101234620
Mira (CS): action items: 1) send outbound to impacted onboarding tenants (I'll send) 2) offer expedited reindex for high-touch 3) AE outreach to renewal accounts 4) collect feedback and invite to office hours
Dev (SRE): posting per-tenant done timestamps here as they finish. Current backlog estimate ~40 minutes.
Mira (CS): thanks all. I'll send comm and paste tenant list here once sent. React with :white_check_mark: after review.
